# Compliance Requirements Quality Checklist: UA-F11 — Privacy, licensing, no-advertising audit and distinctiveness

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of UA-F11: completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, lifecycle
and failure coverage, privacy and no-advertising, accessibility, the simulator/device split, and traceability.
**Created**: 2026-11-13
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Evaluated 2026-11-13 by the lead under the owner's standing delegation. Three items failed on first evaluation
(CHK010, CHK019, CHK022); the specification was corrected and each is marked with the correction.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Does each of the seven acceptance items of the brief map to at least one FR and one SC? [Completeness, Spec §FR-U11-001..072, §SC-U11-001..007] — items 1→FR-001/SC-001, 2→FR-010/SC-002, 3→FR-020/SC-003, 4→FR-030/SC-004, 5→FR-040/SC-005, 6→FR-060/SC-006, 7→FR-070/SC-007.
- [x] CHK002 Are all three owner-only items of the brief, plus D-17's human review, recorded as requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-U11-090..092]
- [x] CHK003 Is every unique requirement of R02-F33, R03-F12 and R04-F12 listed with a disposition and reason? [Traceability, Spec §Absorbed source requirements]
- [x] CHK004 Are the inputs of each check (built app, property list, registrations, catalog, ledger) named in requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-U11-001, 011, 021, 031, 060, 070]
- [x] CHK005 Is the out-of-scope boundary (App Store Connect, store text, privacy policy) stated? [Completeness, Spec §Input]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is "shares a mechanic" defined with an objective rule and a numeric threshold? [Clarity, Spec §FR-U11-061, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK007 Is the mapping of each catalog schema to (core abstraction, player action, win rule) stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-U11-060]
- [x] CHK008 Is "registered experience" tied to a concrete source of truth for permissions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-U11-010, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK009 Is "current build" defined so stale evidence can be detected? [Clarity, Spec §FR-U11-082, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK010 Is the "maintained deny list" given minimum coverage rather than left open? [Clarity, Spec §FR-U11-020] — failed first: no minimum; corrected: four kinds, at least three libraries each.

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Do the redesign-never-merge rule of FR-U11-064 and ADR-0009 D-16 agree? [Consistency, Spec §FR-U11-064]
- [x] CHK012 Is the owner review of distinctiveness non-gating in every place it appears (story 6, FR-092, Input)? [Consistency, Spec §US6, §FR-U11-092]
- [x] CHK013 Are the CI and local responsibilities for built-app checks consistent between Clarifications and Assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK014 Does the no-network requirement agree with Auto-Creator.md §15.2 (StoreKit only)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-U11-024]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK015 Is every success criterion stated with a count, ratio or time? [Measurability, Spec §SC-U11-001..008]
- [x] CHK016 Is the expected size of the matrix (4,950 pairs) and of the inputs (3 experiences today) fixed? [Measurability, Spec §SC-U11-006, 007]
- [x] CHK017 Does each check have a planted-defect criterion so a pass is not vacuous? [Measurability, Spec §FR-U11-083, SC-U11-001..006]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK018 Are failure, missing build, stale build, interruption, memory pressure and newer-version data covered? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK019 Is the split between what the simulator Release build proves and what needs the device build stated? [Coverage, Spec §Assumptions] — failed first: silent; corrected: simulator Release build is gate evidence, signed device archive belongs to UA-F14 and the device campaign; no device requirement.
- [x] CHK020 Are experiences without a win rule and family-shared templates addressed? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK021 Are allowances for system-framework strings bounded by written reasons? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-U11-023]

## Non-Functional: Privacy, No Advertising, Accessibility

- [x] CHK022 Are accessibility requirements (labels, identifiers, target size, Dynamic Type) defined for the acknowledgements screen? [Accessibility, Spec §FR-U11-032] — failed first: only "shown"; corrected, with system audits deferred to the device campaign (owner ruling).
- [x] CHK023 Are privacy answers prevented from being stated without passing scans? [Privacy, Spec §FR-U11-071]
- [x] CHK024 Is "any finding fails the gate" stated without an override path? [No advertising, Spec §FR-U11-023]
- [x] CHK025 Is a time bound given for every check (owner ruling: short tests)? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-U11-083, SC-U11-008]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK026 Are the gate dependencies (UA-F04, UA-F10) and later consumer (UA-F14) named? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, §Input]
- [x] CHK027 Is the A06–A08 microphone permission deferred explicitly rather than silently omitted? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
